name: io.github.claimseed/claimseed
title: claimseed
description: Synthetic US medical-billing documents (PDF and ground truth) for testing extractors and agents

environmentVariables.name: CLAIMSEED_WORKSPACE
environmentVariables.description: Folder for the PDF and ground-truth files (it writes nowhere else); without one, nothing is written

environmentVariables.name: CLAIMSEED_CHROME
environmentVariables.description: Chrome or Chromium binary used for rendering, if not installed in a usual place
